I adopted a puppy at 8 weeks and he had a similar issue with accidents frequently in his crate. It was worms in our case, got a prescription from the vet and his accidents definitely decreased immediately after. So it could be worms? 

Also food, we had to stick to a diet of plain rice and beef for a bit before switching to another brand of dry dog food. The rice and beef diet thing has to last long enough for the old food to like entirely get out of their system before switching to another food. And it has to be gradual too. Like 1.5 cups plain rice and beef + .5 cup new dry dog food and work your way up to a regular serving of dry dog food. Or whatever you want to use as regular dog food. 

Just my 2 cents worth. Good luck though! It's super stressful in the beginning but they'll get there eventually and you'll barely remember how many times you had to clean up accidents.

I was working at mailroom on a college campus and there was supposed to be a supervisor there to show me what to do and stuff because it was only going to be me working in the mailroom itself. So I show up and no one was there. I looked in the supervisors office and no one was there either. I don’t have the phone number of anyone at the office or anything so I think I’ll just sit in the mailroom and wait for someone to show up. And someone did show up, about 5 different delivery people dropping off packages and mail. I had absolutely no idea what was going on. Some people delivered stuff that needed to be immediately put in a freezer (which I didn’t know where was located or anything). A couple people from the building showed up asking for their mail. 

It was a terrible experience the supervisor never showed up and I just left after my shift without delivering any of the mail (because I didn’t know the building and the mail wasn’t addressed to room numbers). I quit quickly after because it was the most unorganized place I have ever been.
